sv.title: Trots Trumps avtal – ingen rysk diesel i USA
sv.summary: Trumps dieselavtal med Vladimir Putin skakade om världen, men en och en halv månad senare har inte en enda rysk oljetanker lagt till i USA.

en.title: Despite Trump's deal – no Russian diesel in the US
en.summary: Trump's diesel deal with Vladimir Putin shook the world, but one and a half months later not a single Russian oil tanker has docked in the US.
